content:
Long before the iPod, the Sony Walkman was the go-to choice for those who wanted a soundtrack to their lives. Now the Duo-Man app recreates that experience, letting those of us who once owned one relive the glory days—and you'll be able to use it with Apple Music…

Before the Walkman, your options for listening to music on the go were pretty limited. Most cassette players at the time were bulky and heavy. Sony took a recorder designed for journalists and shrunk it down into a cassette player as small as it could possibly be, and it quickly became a classic.

Developer Vidit Bhargava created the app at a hackathon—and since many people there had never seen a real Walkman, he brought a physical one to show them what it actually looked like.

You open Duo, pick the album you want to put on the cassette, then close it and playback begins.

Bhargava says he originally built it as a demo app just for fun, but is now releasing it as a full app. The best reply in the X thread is an image that only people of a certain age will truly understand.

What was your first music player? Share in the comments.
